name: MCL Prior-Session Boundary Auction
hypothesis: The previous completed Globex session's own CL and MCL high/low form four immutable auction boundaries; the first joint excursion beyond each side and exactly one next completed five-minute verdict may distinguish accepted discovery from a failed auction at a naturally bounded one-to-two-event daily cadence.

causal_law.prior_session: immediately preceding same-suffix Globex session with at least 200 complete five-minute bars
causal_law.boundaries: independent completed-session CL high/low and MCL high/low
causal_law.excursion: first completed current-session bar whose CL and MCL closes jointly exceed their own prior highs or fall below their own prior lows
causal_law.verdict: exactly the next completed five-minute bar; jointly outside is acceptance/follow, jointly back inside is failed-auction/fade, disagreement consumes the side without a signal
causal_law.multiplicity: each high/low side is consumed once; maximum two events per session
causal_law.entry_readiness: next one-minute same-suffix MCL open exists outside the 16:25–18:00 ET admission blackout

if_eligible: Freeze exact acceptance/failure lifecycle owners before opening PnL; no side, session, clock, or verdict profile may be selected from outcomes.
if_ineligible: Reject prior-session boundary auctions before outcomes; do not widen the verdict, reuse a side, lower completeness/cadence floors, or add thresholds.
